R0061.title: Recycled Phone Number Takeover
R0061.definition: A new phone number holder gains access to the previous holder's account through password recovery or SMS verification code login mechanisms.
R0061.description: A typical malicious attacker can collude with insiders at telecom operators to obtain expired phone numbers in bulk, enabling large-scale account takeovers. Major domestic telecom operators now provide phone number verification APIs that can determine whether a number has been reassigned or expired, allowing platforms to check phone number status accordingly.
R0061.influence: Leads to platform user accounts being impersonated.

references.title: Cyber Black-Grey Market Approaches 100 Billion Yuan: Personal Information Leakage Is the Root Cause

observables: A newly rebindbed phone number triggers the password-recovery or verification-code flow on first login and successfully accesses a historical account
A batch of recycled number ranges concurrently logs into multiple long-dormant accounts with clustered timing
After password recovery, the account profile is immediately modified, or assets are withdrawn or gifted
The carrier's recycled-number status is out of sync with the platform's account-binding status, with sudden changes in login device or region
